description: Select the first, lowest-frequency peak when at most three detected peaks tie for greatest power.

oracle.description: The 90% limits are approximately 0.085 and 0.715 Hz. The detected 0.3 and 0.5 Hz peaks both have power 5, so first-maximum semantics choose 0.3 Hz and delay = round(2 * 0.75 / 0.3) = 5.
